correctness.rationale: The exact conditional binomial law accounts for the shared recovery clock; the latent-time kernel is continuous with derivative supported positively before a and negatively after a. Its Laplace derivative equals B−A. The ratio A/B increases strictly because its logarithmic derivative compares means of disjoint ordered supports, with opposite endpoint signs. Short-window convergence uses normalized Q_U derivatives, whose support shrinks to zero and yields a unique positive limiting equation. Finite independent forward-equation checks reproduce the conditional formula at selected parameters; they are not used as a proof.

value.rationale: The exact one-crossing theorem addresses an intrinsically motivated tradeoff between exposure lag, pre-season recovery, and missing a season. Uniqueness for every monotone payoff is substantive because correlated leaf infections yield nonlinear final-size utilities. A universal short-pulse optimum independent of contact intensity, number of leaves and reward preferences supplies a robust analytic benchmark. No larger-network or other-distribution extension is claimed.
